findings.title: Preserve captured logs when deriving a contextual TestLogger
findings.body: FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log records. LoggerMiddleware now calls logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) for every completion message, so passing a TestLogger to that middleware leaves the injected fake's InfoLogs empty; the completion record exists only on a temporary logger that is immediately discarded. This prevents tests from observing the updated request-logging path. Return the existing fake or make contextual children share its recorded logs.
